script:
#!/bin/bash
# 同步「原版还原包」相关文件到 VPS：逐文件走 API raw，按字节数校验后覆盖。
# 只动本次相关的 7 个文件，不做整站上传（多 Agent 并发规则）。
set -u
API="https://api.github.com/repos/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/contents"
D="/var/www/xinmo-site"
fail=0

pull() {
  rel="$1"; expect="$2"; key="$3"
  tmp="/tmp/_vsync_$(echo "$rel" | tr '/' '_')"
  curl -fsSL -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" \
       -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" \
       -H "User-Agent: xinmo-vps-sync" \
       "$API/$rel?ref=main" -o "$tmp" || { echo "下载失败: $rel"; fail=1; return; }
  size=$(stat -c %s "$tmp")
  if [ "$size" != "$expect" ]; then
    echo "字节不符: $rel 得到 $size 期望 $expect —— 未覆盖"; fail=1; return
  fi
  if [ -n "$key" ] && ! grep -q "$key" "$tmp"; then
    echo "特征串缺失: $rel / $key —— 未覆盖"; fail=1; return
  fi
  sudo install -m 644 -o root -g root "$tmp" "$D/$rel" && echo "已更新: $rel ($size 字节)"
}

pull "tools/etb-vanilla/index.html"             19135 'VANILLA RESTORE'
pull "tools/etb-vanilla/ETB_原版还原包.zip"      15842 ''
pull "tools/etb-vanilla/AI_RESTORE_GUIDE.md"     7349 'AI 还原指南'
pull "tools/etb-vanilla/安装说明_给朋友.txt"      1108 '怎么把游戏变回原版'
pull "tools/etb-vanilla/README_先读我.txt"        4367 '原版还原包'
pull "tools/etbn-mod/index.html"                18493 '“噩梦”模组'
pull "assets/js/resources.js"                   14281 'etb-vanilla'

echo "---- 线上自检 ----"
for f in "tools/etb-vanilla/index.html" "tools/etb-vanilla/ETB_原版还原包.zip" \
         "tools/etb-vanilla/AI_RESTORE_GUIDE.md" "assets/js/resources.js"; do
  echo -n "$f -> "
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{size_download}\n" "https://xinmo.work/$f?t=$(date +%s)"
done
echo -n "模组页标题 -> "
curl -fsS "https://xinmo.work/tools/etbn-mod/index.html?t=$(date +%s)" | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' | head -1
exit $fail
